notes: Hypothesis: learning the entire center correction jointly with multiscale temporal and complex spectral paths, while conditioning each chirp on the rest of the packet, can improve corrections missed by the calibrated DURA operator.

Both U-Nets are randomly initialized. Shared temporal U-Net down/up levels 384/192/96/48, temporal global attention, second 8-token same-capacity attention, learned chirp/time positions, I/Q skip paths, complex FFT branch conditioned on bottleneck context, observed high-band variance and relative edge energy/phase. Only the second attention axis differs. Outputs preserve each chirp dechirped DC and copy its native 48 edges. Final half readout is the deployment output; full edit is source diagnostic.

Train 3600 updates on 20000 lawful U_s IQ packets, held 500, no calibration samples. Same two generic same-packet disturbed observations, weak real source IQ secant probe, and two identity samples per batch. Primary outer/inner split of actual half risk (.5/.5); half complex specimen MSE .25, full waveform .18, time path waveform .15, weak transfer .30, paired consistency .03, identity 1. Fit and freeze receive only source U IQ and own output.

After freezing, use the unchanged PAMF W24 E104 evaluator on the 300-packet Full source panel with all seven views. Candidate half must exceed direct, original long DURA, matched U-Net and best outer-parent half on six scenes, match all four on low urban and match direct on clean. Only qualification launches the three registered Full target shards. All predictions must freeze before separate truth-last score.
